user.title: Add an xTool S1
user.description: Pick how to find your laser. The S1 firmware speaks WebSocket on port 8081.

scan_network.title: Scan the local network
scan_network.description: Enter a CIDR range. Default is your Home Assistant subnet ({suggested}). Maximum 1024 hosts.

scan_results.title: Discovered devices
scan_results.description: Found {count} candidate device(s). Pick the one to add.

manual.title: Enter the IP address
manual.description: IP address or hostname of the laser.

reconfigure.title: Update the IP address
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address of the configured laser. The serial number must match.

error.invalid_network: Not a valid CIDR network range.
error.network_too_large: That range has too many hosts. Use /22 (1024 hosts) or smaller.
error.scan_failed: The network scan failed. Please try again.

abort.no_devices_found: No xTool S1 device found in that range.
abort.wrong_device: The device at this IP has a different serial number than the originally configured one.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the xTool S1 at {host}: {error}

protocol_error.message: Unexpected reply from the xTool S1: {error}
